import { type JSXChildren, type QRL } from '@builder.io/qwik';
import type { OpenChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
import { type Locale } from '../../internal/behavior';
export interface ModalProps {
    id?: string;
    title: JSXChildren;
    titleId?: string;
    description?: JSXChildren;
    descriptionId?: string;
    actions?: JSXChildren;
    open?: boolean;
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    onOpenChange$?: QRL<(details: OpenChangeDetails) => void>;
    closeOnOutsideClick?: boolean;
    showCloseButton?: boolean;
    initialFocusId?: string;
    returnFocusId?: string;
    closeLabel?: string;
    locale?: Locale;
    children?: JSXChildren;
}
export declare const Modal: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<ModalProps>;
